rules: Official Sportstiming data is the result source of record when available.
Organizer-published route files and race PMs outrank secondary course databases.

Trace de Trail references created by ÖST are authoritative route leads; public GPX acquisition may be automated when a normal public download is exposed, while acquisition and redistribution are treated as separate provenance decisions.
A user-supplied race-day GPX may validate route geometry and barometric elevation shape, but it does not silently override organizer geometry or an official timing observation.

A public participant race-day recording may independently support actual race-day geometry, distance and route-change evidence when its event/year/participant linkage is verified; it does not silently override organizer route provenance.
Public mapped routes and derivative route repositories are acquisition/cross-check leads unless provenance establishes that they are an actual race-day recording or organizer publication.
The national elevation model is authoritative only for the project's harmonized terrain-elevation layer; it never changes horizontal route geometry or official published ascent claims.
ITRA, UTMB and DUV are cross-check sources and never silently overwrite official timing or organizer route data.
Race-day marking may differ from a published GPX; this limitation must remain explicit in public methodology.
Unknown values remain null and are never inferred into official observations.

sources.note: Project owner authorized automated acquisition through Trace de Trail's normal public GPX download path on 2026-09-10. This authorization is operational; third-party redistribution rights are evaluated separately.
The user states the elevation values originate from the watch barometer. The raw GPX is not required by the analysis engine; a provenance-preserving derived reference is stored.
Only activities with verified event/year linkage are retained as race-day evidence. Public metadata may be retained even when coordinates/GPX export require account access.
Activity references are catalogued when the public landing page identifies the athlete/race; login-gated maps or exports are not bypassed.
Route titles and labels are user-supplied metadata unless separate provenance proves organizer or race-day origin.
Derivative copies, including routes explicitly sourced from Trace de Trail, are not treated as independent race-day geometry evidence.
Use the current Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning ground DEM (1 m grid, SWEREF 99 TM / RH 2000) for a harmonized derived elevation layer. Preserve source/barometric elevation separately.
